review_type: separate local automated read-only source and retained-evidence review

observations.trigger: Independent supplied immutable tasks use thread/process mode
observations.consequence: Independent instrument components execute concurrently, same/intersecting instruments and session history remain ordered. All publication follows complete compute and is coordinator-owned. Parallelism is coarse compute-only, not automatic parallel acquisition/publication.
observations.recommendation: Keep purity and coordinator sink ownership. Measure complete representative pipelines before selecting worker counts; do not present pool support as demonstrated speedup.

observations.trigger: 64 instruments x 256 synthetic trades, three repeats for each mode and sink
observations.consequence: Sequential median Parquet 69.3332328s versus threads2 72.5743428s and threads4 77.2374497s. DuckDB 205.4601907s versus 217.1562376s and 214.9572834s. Current evidence does not support a wider default.
observations.recommendation: Retain sequential1. Attribute conversion, codec, source setup, publication, readback and catalog costs before further scheduling work.

observations.trigger: Caller requests bounded resources or cancellation
observations.consequence: Budgets reserve logical serialized populations, not total Python/native RSS. Thread counts are caller declarations, not enforced native thread controls. Cancellation stops unsubmitted shards and publication, but running coarse shards are joined and can run to completion.
observations.recommendation: Retain explicit limits and trusted-local scope. Benchmark native thread settings jointly with process count; do not claim hard memory caps or hard cancellation deadlines.

observations.trigger: Same compatible config/input/initialization reused across tasks
observations.consequence: Reuse identity includes config, inputs, instruments, calendar, warmup and initialization. Cache is explicit caller-owned and does not itself acquire inputs. No universal feature planner or shared-memory process cache follows.
observations.recommendation: Prefer one acquisition per immutable instrument/session scope and fused multi-feature calculations. Keep revision/cutoff/initialization in reuse keys.

observations.consequence: Task OS locks are retained for claim lifetime, live expiry never steals ownership, retained intents require actual sink receipt/content readback before success and uncertain states are not blindly replayed.
observations.recommendation: Keep conservative actual-readback recovery. Any throughput work must preserve exact identity, full evidence, idempotency, locking and uncertain-commit handling.

coverage_limits: No new test, benchmark, native process, package build/install, API or workload run. Existing JSON reports are retained execution evidence, not independently rerun measurements.
Performance measurements are historical frozen source cohorts; current source review does not convert them into new-head performance qualification.
No exhaustive mathematical proof or every calculator review; numerical correctness beyond orchestration is reviewed separately by the parent/core reviewer.
No real licensed provider workload, annual workload, production capacity, hard host resource enforcement, independent human review or Linux full timing claim.
No concrete new worker correctness defect established in inspected paths; direction recommendations are not bug findings or implementation approval.
recommended_sequence: Freeze one representative target workload and full parity oracle, including task count, records per instrument, histories, schema, source and sink.
Measure serial acquisition/setup, canonical materialization, pure compute, codec/hash, sink commit/readback and generation/catalog under caller-visible boundaries.
Optimize measured serialization/conversion and repeated setup first with unchanged public bytes and negative/security controls.
Compare fused per-instrument batches plus sequential/thread/process configurations on both supported platforms; cap nested native threads and record process startup/IPC.
Adopt parallel defaults only for a demonstrated workload class with full numerical/quality/evidence/input identity parity and explicit fallback; retain conservative default otherwise.
